caption: The drawing consists of two centrally aligned square patterns rendered on a cream or off-white background. The top square is composed of a repeating pattern in shades of brown and beige, featuring a network of curved, leaf-like shapes and small circular elements at the intersections. The bottom square also displays a repetitive motif, predominantly in dark brown and accented with small, evenly spaced ovals or elliptical shapes filled with a red and white design. Near the bottom right corner of the drawing, outside the patterned areas, the name "E. Williams" is written in cursive. The squares do not touch and have clear space between them and all four edges of the paper.
title: Printed Cotton Swatches
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
